# Nythera

Nythera is a technology and creative company building digital experiences across operating systems, television, artificial intelligence and entertainment.

## Projects

- Nythera Movies: https://nytheramovies.vercel.app/
- Nythera OS (PC): https://nythera-pc.vercel.app/
- Nythera OS (TV): https://nythera-tv.vercel.app/
- Nythera AI: https://nytherai.vercel.app/
